data.design: Use the established Zigzagoon silhouette, angular brown-and-cream coat and low searching posture. Proposed field tracks change direction twice across a soft verge; keep their scale small enough to belong to this animal rather than a path marker.

description:
An ordinary Normal Pokémon in the South Coast Road’s grass. Its native species account describes a searching nose and a wandering route that leaves zigzag tracks. It evolves into Linoone at level 20. Its inherited Pickup ability does not authorize story-critical objects to disappear from people or the player.

Proposed roadside behavior: it checks the ground around a recently lifted crate, retraces two steps, then follows a different smell into the verge. A scrap of food may interest it while an expensive tool does not. This keeps roadside scavenging distinct from the boys’ deliberate theft. A traveler can close a food bundle or let the animal finish investigating before taking it up. A recruited individual still wants to check the place where the party rested; its small delay can be familiar and amusing without an obedience penalty.
